description: Implementation of the Framebuffer9 class for Direct3D 9 rendering in ANGLE, including methods for discard, invalidate, clear, readPixels, blit, and state synchronization.

classes.name: Framebuffer9
classes.description: A class implementing framebuffer operations for Direct3D 9 in ANGLE.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Stub method for discarding framebuffer attachments; unreachable in this implementation.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Stub method for invalidating framebuffer attachments; unreachable in this implementation.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Stub method for sub-region invalidation; unreachable in this implementation.

methods.name: clearImpl
methods.description: Performs clearing of the framebuffer's render target and depth/stencil buffers.

methods.name: readPixelsImpl
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the framebuffer, handling multisampling and direct pixel transfer.

methods.name: blitImpl
methods.description: Performs blitting (copying) between framebuffers, including color and depth/stencil buffers.

methods.name: getRenderTargetImplementationFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the render target for use in the implementation.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Unreachable stub for getting sample positions.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the framebuffer state with the GL context state.
